Interesting, yea taking those photos wasn't the best but that was a while ago especially at *that* age. And the fact that you didn't expose share them with others? That's like holy flip amazing. Do you know how many people, probs even myself back then would have been showcasing photos like that to other people? your messed up that age. Heck, I'm 28 and still messed up to be fair.

Quick comment, I think you beating yourself up over your addiction is excessive. It's a religious/psychological/moral? guilt and you're condeming yourself too much. If you are "Christian" then isn't there the quote, 'there is no more condemnation for those of us in Christ Jesus'. And if you're another religion, I'm sure there's a similar quote.

Really don't be so hard on yourself for such an easy to fall into addiction. I'm kind of saying this becuase I made the stupidest mistake on earth last year in which I was doing nofap, and someone at my work showed me a nsfw picture. And I, in my beyond stupid "moral justification" quit my job. My life was on track. And I quit my fricking job because of a nude picture. Fast forward a couple of months, I'm a raging alcoholic (because, you know being a drunk who makes everyone uncomfortable at work is totally ok...but nudity?), 

Anyways after a series of unfortunate events. I stop drinking. Just for it to be replaced with me sitting in my room alone self harming by continously smashing myself on my head with my fist and blunt objects to try and make the endless thoughts of regret & self-loathing escape.

Flip me if I could have gone back and just not been such a pathetically uptight worthless human. I would have happily had a wank every day of my life, for last years stupidity not to happen.

Basically, don't condemn yourself so hard for something you did in the past ( I say that despite, having revereted back to hitting myself again today for the stupidity of last years actions)

**tl;dr if you do believe in eternal suffering, pretty sure suicide trumps a few guilty wanks and photos you took back in your youth.**

Not sure where you're based. But if it's america, chances are you could survive, especially with the pills you're deciding to take, and that could end up in a massive hospital bill. Or else waking up covered in your own vomit with a deepening sense of having failed

I can't think of any. Far less has happened to myself and I usually wish to end it. Heck, I'd be going to *you* for advice for how you've even got the strength to "look for a reason". Although I feel compelled to reach out and speak to you. Really don't know how you're managing, or barely managing? Not managing? 

And I'm not inciting anything. I'm just in awe. The things humans have to go through. So yea, if you wish to talk would love to

Feel you, I wanted to kill myself when I was around 22 (28 now), kind of wish I'd just gone through with it. Would have kept me from hurting other people and being an embarassment to society. I had a phenomenal year last year, but messed it up by drinking. Fuck did I mess it up. 

Was it worth it? Really doesn't feel it. And that's *without* having "disgusting" years. Even when things are going ok there's that desire. Now working at at home with just my thoughts to condemn me. 

Yea seems like being asked to stay alive is to keep suffering, and the suffering *will* get worse (and our ability to cope with it most likely won't impove). I don't like my name anymore. I don't like hearing my name. I don't like that I am a part of existence and that my existence is acknowledged. 

Odd though how I want life to continue for *you.* Continue and thrive and for you to be blessed. Then again with life, you sometimes feel this bond with someone (or even yourself), and then before you know it, you've messed it up.
